criteria.description: 现有 Agent 路径迁移到真实 LangGraph 状态图与 LangChain 有范围约束的工具，保留所有能力、单次发送和严格结果验证。
提供中文代码导读和离线可运行示例，解释循环终止、工具观察合并、上下文来源、明确保存偏好与工程经验记忆；示例不收费，验证跨请求隔离和无自动记忆写入。
保留当前权限、确切请求预扣、取消不确定占额、无重试、库存事务幂等；完整有界10家庭20客户端30秒负载及桌面手机业务复核。
tests: web/e2e/intake-scope.spec.ts#intake rejects unrelated voice and image and confirms explicit corrections
web/e2e/voice-intake.spec.ts#voice intake requires consent, editable quantities and explicit atomic confirmation
web/e2e/community-review.spec.ts#community cover rejection, explicit resubmission and private service failure
web/e2e/menu-cancel.spec.ts#menu requires a deliberate meal selection and cancelled recommendations stay dismissed
web/e2e/workflow.spec.ts#UI kitchen workflow purchases shortages and consumes exactly once

feedback.evaluation_exemption: Framework orchestration migration with unchanged model prompts and deterministic local HTTP fixtures. No paid model evaluation is authorized; model quality improvement is not claimed. Named graph/schema/bridge regressions and full/acceptance must all pass.
feedback.device_exemption: No microphone/camera capture changes; desktop/mobile browser regressions cover affected flows. Existing physical-device limitations remain unchanged.
